title: Collision probability for a uniform tuple
statement: Let $r$ and $M$ be natural numbers with $M>0$, and let $i,j\in\{0,ldots,r-1\}$ be distinct. If a tuple of length $r$ is chosen uniformly from ${0,ldots,M-1}^r$, the probability that its entries at $i$ and $j$ agree is $1/M$.
hypotheses_covered: $i,j$ are indices in a tuple of length $r$
